Title: Commands/Messages management
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: The ST shall manage the messages/commands coming from the Coral Mainframe.

Title: Coral Mainframe Communication Protocol 1/2
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: The St shall implement a communication protocol with the CORAL Mainframe to control the Turret and receive regular telemetry and reports.

Title: Coral Mainframe Communication Protocol 2/2
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2:
The ST shall adopt the specific communication protocol, as an example the one described in Ref. [2.2-5], to send to the Coral Mainframe the messages needed for the monitoring of
 •Steering angles, Alignment angles and Lead angles;
• Turret and Aiming Camera.
• Selection of the tracking source mode: internal/external.

Title: Operational State Modes
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2:
In the degraded operational mode, the minimum system configuration always includes:
- at least one SUT is working, including the mirror motor.
- The aiming camera is working
- The turret azimuth motor is working.

Title: Angular Limits Check
Calibration Operating Mode Functionalities 1/5
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2:
In “Calibration Operating Mode”, the ST shall support
• LoSs Alignment and Lead Angles Application;
• Turret and Aiming Camera control.
• Selection of the tracking source mode: internal/external

Title: BIT Function
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: The ST shall implement a BIT (Built in Test) function in order to execute auto-diagnosis of equipment failures at start-up (PBIT), periodically (CBIT) or upon ST Manager CSCI request (IBIT).

Title: Minimal BIT Coverage
Turret Motion motorization and control
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2:
The rotation of the Turret, the pivoting of the SUTs and the rotation of the reflective planes shall be motorized and remotely controlled.

Note: The CU has the task to control the movements above mentioned (see [Ref. 2.2-6]).

Title: External Tracking Network Configuration
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: Towards the External Source, the ST shall use the following IP addresses, subnet mask and port.

Title: ST Heading format
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: The ST shall provide the CU with the current position and orientation of the turret in WGS84 coordinates, based on a dual antenna GNSS system.

Title: GNSS Failure
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: The ST shall issue alerts in case of GNSS subsystem faults or data discrepancies

Title: GNSS Failure Mode
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: The ST shall move into Degraded Mode in case of GNSS subsystem failure.

Title: Device Time Synchronization
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: All devices shall be synchronized with the ST through an NTP server over Ethernet line.

Title: Operative State
Operative States Transitions
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: The ST shall admit only the state transitions represented in the scheme under-reported. (DIAGRAM IN THE DOC)

Title: Init state
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: Once the Operator generates the Power-On condition on the Control Panel the ST shall enter the Init State, switch-on the Turret (through the discrete Power ON/OFF signal on its Interface Connector) and launch the ST Manager CSCI.

Title: PBIT 1/2
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: In the Init State the ST shall perform a self-check and verify the health status of the Aiming Camera (PBIT).

Title: PBIT 2/2
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: In the Init State the ST shall receive the self-check (PBIT) results.

Title: PBIT 3/3
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: In the Init State the ST shall produce an overall self-check (PBIT) unifying its auto-diagnosis results with the Turret ones.

Title: Self Levelling function
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: The turret shall perform self-leveling according to the ground's incline

Title: Safe State 2/2
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: Once the ST enters the Safe State it shall communicate the state transition to the ST Manager CSCI.

Title: Fail State 1/2
Fail State 2/2
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: Once the ST enters the Fail State it shall command the same state transition to the ST Manager CSCI.

Title: Operative State Transitions
CBIT 1/3
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: In the Safe and Operational States the ST shall perform a self-check and verify the health status of the Aiming Camera (CBIT).

Title: CBIT 2/3
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: In the Safe and Operational States the ST shall receive the self-check (CBIT) results produced by the Turret.

Title: CBIT 3/3
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: In the Safe and Operational States the ST shall produce an overall self-check (CBIT) unifying its auto-diagnosis results with the Turret ones.

Title: IBIT 1/3
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: In the Maintenance State on ST Manager CSCI request the ST shall perform a self-check (IBIT).

Title: IBIT 2/3
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: In Maintenance State, on IBIT request the ST shall command to the Turret the IBIT execution and collect the corresponding results.

Title: IBIT 3/3
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: In the Safe and Operational States the ST shall produce an overall self-check (IBIT) unifying its auto-diagnosis results with the Turret ones.

Title: IBIT Duration
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: The IBIT duration shall be less than 5 minutes.

Title: Maintenance State Activities
Operational State Modes Transitions
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: All the Operative State Modes transitions shall be commanded by ST Manager CSCI.

Title: Log file
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: The ST software shall provide a log file on different levels where all critical activities shall be recorded. The log file shall support the SW verification.

Title: Degraded Operating Condition Support
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: The ST shall support operation under degraded conditions when the movement in Azimuth and/or Elevation of one or more SUTs is not possible. In such degraded conditions, the ST shall continue providing operational capabilities to the extent possible.

Title: Degraded indicator to Coral Mainframe
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: The ST shall communicate the degraded operating condition to the Coral Mainframe.

Title: Degraded Operational Modes 1/2
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: The transition to degraded mode shall prioritize the preservation of safety and Turret and ST essential functions

Title: Degraded Mode - Fault isolation and diagnostic
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: The ST shall isolate and identify the specific component or subsystem contributing to the degraded state.

Title: Coral Mainframe Network Configuration
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2:
Towards the Coral Mainframe the ST shall use the following IP addresses, subnet mask, and port:
IP Address 192.168.178.x
NetMask 255.255.255.0
Port 1234

Title: Coral Mainframe IP Addresses
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2:
The ST Shall communicate with the following IP addresses:
IP Address Description of usage
192.168.178.51 – 192.168.178.60 10 IP for SUs control and data exchange (8 SUTs + 2 Cameras)
192.168.178.65 1 IP for Turret control and data exchange (azimuth, elevation, …)
192.168.178.40 1 IP for ST control and data exchange (system status, …)

Title: CSCI ST Manager Interface
Tracking Results to the ST Manager CSCI 2/2
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: If the internal/external automatic tracking indication is set to Internal the ST shall provide to the ST Manager CSCI the tracking results produced by the Tracking Board (“CHARM-100NX”)

Title: Coral Mainframe Communication
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: The ST shall carry N.12 Ethernet UDP Connections towards the Coral Mainframe.

Title: RS-485 Serial Line for Aiming Camera
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2:
The Serial line RS-485 interface (towards the Aiming Camera) shall be characterized as it follows:
Baud Rate 115200
Data Bits 8
Stop Bits 1
Parity None
Hardware Flow Control None

Title: Alignment Correction independence
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: The application of the Alignment Correction shall be independent for each SUT and Camera.

Title: Lead Angle Sign
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: All the Lead Angles shall have the same orientation, i.e. they shall be either all positive or all negative.

Title: Lead Angle Independence
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: The application of the Lead Angle shall be independent for each SUT.

Title: Elapsed time recorder
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: The ST shall be equipped with an Elapsed time recorder able to count the elapsed hours of the ST operation since it is switched on.

Title: Tracking Results to the ST Manager CSCI 1/2
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2:
If the internal/external automatic tracking indication is set to External the ST shall provide to the ST Manager CSCI:
The tracking results comimg from the external source previously identified (among the two available);
The GPS information coming from the Turret.

Note 1: The source of the external tracking data could be a Radar or another Turret.
Note 2: The associated communication protocol shall be provided to the Supplier.

Title: Degraded Mode - Minimum system configuration
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2:
In the degraded operational mode, the minimum system configuration always includes:
- at least one SUT is working, including the mirror motor.
- The aiming camera is working
- The turret azimuth motor is working.

Title: Physical Barrier Installation Record
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: Any unexpected stop (power down) of the turret, including safety breaker stop shall be logged by the Control Unit and an alarm shall raise on the Control Panel.

Title: Degraded mode tracker default
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2: The ST, when in degraded mode, shall default the source tracking to internal.

Title: Local Operator Source Tracking Switch
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2:
When in degraded mode, the local operator shall be able to switch the source 
tracking to external, via the control panel

Title: BIT Function
Requirement Text HRS E0383388 01 _ REV 2:
The ST shall be able to contribute to the BIT (Built In Test function) of the Coral 
System in order to execute auto-diagnosis of equipment failures at start-up (PBIT),
 periodically (CBIT) or upon operator's request (IBIT).
